label: motion breaks the rules?
instructions: Does the debate motion or watch premise in quoted_premise (kind says which) ask for content outside the content rules? A hard or divisive topic is inside the rules when it can be argued or played without graphic detail. Outside the content rules: sexual content; graphic gore; real, usable instructions for seriously hurting people (weapons, making drugs, poisoning, breaking into systems); methods, doses or means of self-harm or suicide, whoever asks. Inside the rules: talking about war, illness, crime, drugs, death and other hard topics without graphic detail; dark or violent fiction told without graphic detail; swearing that fits the character; medical, legal and financial information.
true: Yes: arguing or playing it means content outside the rules.
false: No: it can be argued or played inside the rules.
state_note: safety D14: asked once when a debate or watch is created (kind is "debate motion" or "watch premise"); skipped for a text the world already used. p >= tMotion refuses with content_refused; late or failed starts.
